Version 1.0 of Urban Strife features the full campaign, complete progression systems, expanded faction content, and the final chapter, where you must defend Urban Shelter against the massive Atlanta Horde. 

Set in a devastated corner of the American South, Urban Strife blends old-school turn-based tactics with deep survival mechanics, shelter management, faction politics, and meaningful RPG storytelling. Recruit survivors, rebuild a struggling community, forge uneasy alliances, and fight to protect everything you've built against ruthless factions and overwhelming undead hordes.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a look at some of the locations you'll explore on your journey through 19th-century Japan in this latest Shadow of the Road trailer for the upcoming tactical RPG. Shadow of the Road is set in a world where the land’s ancient heritage is confronted by the steam-powered advance of modernization. Shadow of the Road will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.

Shadow of the Road's Japan depicts an alternative version of the 19th-century Bakumatsu Period — a country full of clashing factions and world views, where a group of travelers become embroiled in the war between Shōgun and Emperor. However, it’s not just traditional soldiers they have to deal with: The East Nippon Company has bolstered the Emperor’s forces with advanced mechs, wreaking havoc on both military and civilians. Furthermore, the kami and yōkai, entities from Japan’s folklore and mythology that are also a part of this world, have their own goals.
title: Shadow of the Road - Official Environments Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
D-topia is available now on PC via Steam and Epic Games Store, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox (X|S, Windows). Watch the D-topia launch trailer for this gentle-paced puzzle adventure game. 

Welcome to D-topia. As part of the Utopia Project, D-topia was created to maximize human happiness and comfort. Step into a future where happiness is curated by artificial intelligence in D-topia. 

Tackle fun logic-based puzzles to resolve mechanical issues and keep the facilities running smoothly and meet the many vibrant residents, each with their own unique story and personal struggle.

But what happens when problems go beyond the mechanical? How will your choices impact the wellbeing of the residents, and the future of humanity? In a world of curated happiness, what does it mean to find purpose?
title: D-topia - Official Launch Trailer

description:
Join members of the development team for an update on what's coming with the League of Legends Classic next patch, including Act One of this Season and a general celebration of earlier times, with an early Summoner's Rift map, champion roster and kits, items, and more. Get a closer look at gameplay changes in League of Legends Classic with game director for League Classic Brian Feeney (FeralPony) and game designer David Turley (Phreak). 

On July 29 in Patch 26.15, League of Legends will release League of Legends Classic, a new gameplay experience that recreates the feel of early League while modernizing select systems. While anchored in 2013's Season 3, League Classic gameplay is a collection of greatest hits from across early League rather than an exact recreation of a single patch.

League of Legends Classic will also feature old-school Runes and Masteries, items, Summoner Spells, a starting roster of 60 classic champions with many pre-rework kits, and a recreation of the early Sum
title: League of Legends - Official Classic, Mayhem & More Dev Update
